nodes.text: Let $C>1$. Does the set of integers of the form $p+\lfloor C^k\rfloor$, for some prime $p$ and $k\geq 0$, have density $>0$?

#244 : [Er61,p.230] number theory | primes Originally asked to Erdős by Kalmár. Erdős believed the answer is yes. Romanoff [Ro34] proved that the answer is yes if $C$ is an integer. Ding [Di25] has proved that this is true for almost all $C>1$.
